author: Seung Wook
problem: Each line of a coastguard radio log looks like 'CALLSIGN: message'. Return a dict mapping each callsign to its messages, in log order.
bug_description: Uses rpartition(':') instead of partition(':'), so a message containing a colon (like a time '14:30') is split at the wrong place.

comments.accurate: Groups each callsign's messages in log order
comments.wrong_behavior: Groups messages by callsign, splitting each line at its last colon
comments.wrong_location: Line split verified; check repeated callsigns add to the same list
